{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for invalid values
invalid_values = df[df['revenue_clean'].isna()]['revenue'].unique()
print("Invalid revenue values:", invalid_values)

# The only invalid value is '999,999.99' — this has a comma, not a dot
# We need to handle the comma: replace comma with dot, then convert
# Create a clean version of the revenue column
# First, replace comma with dot in the original string
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '.', regex=False)

# Now convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining NaNs
remaining_nans = df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum()
print("Remaining NaNs after cleaning:", remaining_nans)

# Show the first few cleaned values
print("First 10 cleaned revenue values:")
print(df['revenue_clean'].head(10))"}
